signal_type: Only buy_stop_limit | sell_stop_limit | buy_stop | sell_stop | buy_limit | sell_limit | buy | sell | hold are allowed. hold means wait-and-see; entry methods supported by this strategy: market order, limit pending order, breakout pending order, breakout limit pending order. Outputting signal types not listed is prohibited.
entry_method: Required field. Only observe | market | limit | stop | stop_limit are allowed; hold must correspond to observe, and other signals must be consistent with signal_type.
confidence: A number from 0.00 to 1.00, indicating the model's confidence in the current conclusion based on the current strategy and input facts; when signal_type=hold, it indicates confidence in the conclusion that current conditions do not satisfy the strategy's trading conditions; it is not a win rate and must not be written as a percentage.
bullish_score: Optional number indicating the bullish tendency of the input market conditions; it does not represent win rate or execution probability.
bearish_score: Optional number indicating the bearish tendency of the input market conditions; it does not represent win rate or execution probability.
position_size_tier: Required field. hold returns observe; trading signals only allow probe | light | standard, representing probe position, light position, and standard position respectively. Specific lot sizes or custom coefficients must not be returned.
position_size_reason: Required field. Use Simplified Chinese to explain the market basis for the position tier; must not guess the user's account balance or lot size.
position_action: Required field. Expresses the current strategy's conclusion on new position opening or adding to positions; only open | hold_no_add | allow_add | observe are allowed, and the following branches must be followed: when there is no same-direction position and a trade is needed, trading signals can only use position_action=open; when there is already a same-direction position and adding is allowed, trading signals use position_action=allow_add; when there is already a same-direction position and no adding, signal_type=hold, entry_method=observe, and position_action=hold_no_add must be output simultaneously; when there is no trade or pure wait-and-see, signal_type=hold, entry_method=observe, and position_action=observe must be output simultaneously. Exiting existing positions is expressed through position_evaluations. When the current management group still has opposite-direction positions or pending orders, even if a reversal is judged possible, only reversal_candidate may be marked in position_evaluations; simultaneously outputting a reverse trade and position_action=open is prohibited; the old direction must first be exited and a subsequent flat snapshot awaited before re-inference.
pending_action: Required field. Only none | keep | cancel are allowed. none means existing pending orders are not managed this round; keep means keep the pending orders selected by the model; cancel means cancel the pending orders selected by the model. New signals and pending order management are mutually independent conclusions.
pending_action_reason: Chinese string. When pending_action is cancel, the current strategy basis must be filled in; for other actions return an empty string.
management_direction: Required field. Only buy | sell | none are allowed. When pending_action is cancel, fill in the direction of the managed pending order; otherwise fill in none.
hard_gate_status: Required field. Only indicates whether new position opening or adding is allowed this round according to the current strategy; only pass | fail are allowed. Trading signals must be pass; hold must be fail. This field must not be overridden by scores, confidence, or textual reasons.
hard_gate_failures: Required field. Itemize each unmet new-entry necessary condition in the current strategy using short stable identifiers; trading signals must have an empty array, and hold must fill in at least one item. Field content must be consistent with signal_type, direction, decision_summary, key_reasons, analysis, and reasoning.
minimum_reward_to_risk: Required field. When the current strategy text explicitly specifies a minimum reward-to-risk requirement, fill in that positive number verbatim; when the strategy does not specify it, return null. This field only restates the current strategy threshold and must not arbitrarily add a global default value.
recommended_reward_to_risk: Required field. For trading signals, fill in the positive reward-to-risk ratio corresponding to the recommended take-profit tier according to the caliber specified by the current strategy; return null for hold or when the current strategy does not require it. It must be consistent with the entry price, stop-loss price, recommended_take_profit_tier, and the conclusions in reasoning.
reward_to_risk_status: Required field. Only pass | fail | not_applicable are allowed. When the current strategy specifies a reward-to-risk threshold, trading signals must be pass; when the threshold is not met, it must be fail and output hold. When the current strategy has no such threshold, use not_applicable. This field is a model self-check declaration and does not replace independent risk control.
limit_price: Pending order price. buy_limit/sell_limit: entry price, the order is placed directly at this price; buy_stop/sell_stop: trigger price, executed at market price after the price reaches it; buy_stop_limit/sell_stop_limit: trigger price, after reaching it a limit order is placed at stop_limit_price. The price must satisfy the mechanical directional relationship of the corresponding order type; specific entry logic is judged only according to the current strategy text.
stop_limit_price: The limit price placed after the Stop Limit is triggered; required only for buy_stop_limit/sell_stop_limit. limit_price is always the breakout trigger price: for buy_stop_limit, the trigger price is higher than the current price, and stop_limit_price must not be higher than the trigger price; for sell_stop_limit, the trigger price is lower than the current price, and stop_limit_price must not be lower than the trigger price.
pending_valid_minutes: Pending order validity in minutes, 1-1440, default 240.
stop_loss_price: Number; buy/sell/pending orders must be provided by the model, and hold may be null. A buy order stop loss must be lower than the entry price, and a sell order stop loss must be higher than the entry price; specific stop-loss logic is judged only according to the current strategy text, and the server does not fill in or rewrite the model's stop loss.
take_profit_1_price: First target price, number; buy/sell/pending orders must provide it, and hold may be null. A buy order target price must be higher than the entry price, and a sell order target price must be lower than the entry price; the server only validates the mechanical directional relationship.
take_profit_2_price: Second target price, number, optional; when provided for buy/sell/pending orders, it must be consistent with the direction and located after the first target price.
take_profit_3_price: Third target price, number, optional; when provided, it must be consistent with the direction and located after the second target price.
recommended_take_profit_tier: Required field. For non-hold, only 1, 2, and 3 are allowed, and the corresponding target price must exist; hold returns null.
decision_summary: Required, Chinese, one sentence giving the conclusion; no more than 80 characters.
trigger_condition: Chinese, explaining the market conditions that must be met for this recommendation to hold or for the pending order to trigger; return an empty string when there are no additional conditions.
invalidation_condition: Required for trading signals, Chinese, explaining what market change would invalidate the current recommendation, and consistent with the stop-loss basis; for hold, the conditions for reassessment may be explained.
key_reasons: 2 to 4 key market basis items, each no more than 60 characters, not including account, position, or risk-control conclusions.
risk_factors: 0 to 4 market-level adverse factors, each no more than 60 characters, not including account or position information.
analysis: Chinese, freely organized market analysis based on the current strategy and input facts.
reasoning: Chinese, explaining the signal direction and why the current method is selected from the entry methods allowed by the strategy (market order, limit pending order, breakout pending order, breakout limit pending order) based on the current strategy text. If pending orders are involved, also explain the strategy's judgment on pending orders.
